summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale overnight drone offensive targeting Kyiv with at least five Geran-5 Shaheds circling the capital and additional reactive UAVs penetrating northern, central, and southern Ukrainian regions. Ukrainian strikes disabled key substations in occupied Crimea, cutting power to approximately 90% of the peninsula and parts of Rostov region. A ballistic missile threat from Russia's Kursk region was also reported.
key_points: At least five Geran-5 drones circled Kyiv and its outskirts while multiple reactive UAVs approached from Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Black Sea directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77513)
Ukrainian strikes on Crimean substations left ~90% of the peninsula and parts of Rostov region without electricity. (Source: @UkraineNow/84867)
Air raid alert in Kyiv lasted from 01:48 to 04:32 amid ballistic missile threat from Kursk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/125915, @eRadarrua/125973, @mon1tor_ua/77503)

Reactive UAVs detected across nine oblasts: Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kyiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv. (Source: @kpszsu/90093, @kpszsu/90031, @kpszsu/90062, @kpszsu/90099, @kpszsu/90035, @kpszsu/90101, @kpszsu/90108, @kpszsu/90109, @kpszsu/90098, @kpszsu/90040, @kpszsu/90058, @kpszsu/90055, @kpszsu/90037, @kpszsu/90077, @kpszsu/90060, @kpszsu/90053, @kpszsu/90059)
Massive UAV attack hit chemical plant in Tolyatti, Samara region, Russia, causing large fire and AvtoVAZ worker evacuation. (Source: @eRadarrua/125978)

Cabinet created Coordination Center for reservation, lowered critical threshold for energy/defense to 95%, and finalized reforms ending 100% blanket reservations. (Source: @UkraineNow/84872, @DeepStateUA/23929)

Defense Procurement Agency contracted 300% more non-FPV UAVs than 2025, FPV contracting up 54%, deliveries up 3.7x; also procuring aircraft, tactical missiles, 5,000 pickups, long-range 155mm shells. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23928)
Zelensky stated Ukraine ready to freeze war at current front line but will not cede territory or recognize occupied lands as Russian. (Source: @UkraineNow/84868)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a massive overnight drone wave targeting Kyiv with five Geran-5s circling the capital while reactive UAVs struck across nine Ukrainian oblasts from northern, central, and southern axes. Ukrainian counter-strikes on Crimean energy infrastructure disabled key substations, blacking out ~90% of the peninsula and parts of Rostov region. A concurrent ballistic missile threat from Kursk region prompted extended air raid alerts in Kyiv.

points: Ukrainian forces struck key substations in occupied Crimea, leaving approximately 90% of the peninsula and parts of Rostov region without electricity, per OSINT reports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84867, @eRadarrua/125984)
The General Staff announced a humanitarian ceasefire in occupied Oleshky, Kherson region, effective 03:00 on October 27. (Source: @UkraineNow/84864)

The Cabinet of Ministers established a Coordination Center for reservation and reduced the critical reservation threshold for energy and defense sectors to 95%, requiring central authorities and regional administrations to review criticality criteria within 10 days. (Source: @UkraineNow/84872)

The government finalized reservation system reforms: maximum reservation no longer 100% for defense and energy enterprises; new mechanism allows 100% reservation if enterprises regularly voluntarily send workers to military service; criteria for criticality separated from economic indicators. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23929)

Defense Procurement Agency (AOZ) contracted 300% more non-FPV UAVs than in 2025, FPV contracting up 54% and deliveries up 3.7x; also procuring aircraft, tactical missiles, quad bikes, motorcycles, buggies, women's body armor, anti-concussion suits, 5,000 pickups, and long-range 155mm artillery shells saving 16% via competition. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23928)

President Zelensky stated Ukraine is ready to freeze the war at the current front line but will not cede more territory or recognize occupied lands as Russian; he would sign a peace deal immediately if possible. (Source: @UkraineNow/84868)

Ukraine's air defense engaged multiple waves of Russian Shahed/Geran-5 drones and reactive UAVs across at least nine oblasts overnight, with air raid alerts in Kyiv lasting from 01:48 to 04:32. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77512, @eRadarrua/125915, @eRadarrua/125973, @kpszsu/90077)

Russian forces launched at least 5 Geran-5 drones circling over Kyiv and its outskirts, plus additional Shaheds approaching Kyiv from Chernihiv region (Vyshhorod district) and a reactive Shahed near Cherkasy (Boryspil district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77513, @mon1tor_ua/77512)

Reactive UAVs were detected across northern Ukraine: from Bryansk region past Slavutych and Snovsk into Chernihiv region; past Narodychi in Zhytomyr region; towards Olevsk; and from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv and Odesa regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/125920, @eRadarrua/125923, @kpszsu/90037, @kpszsu/90098, @kpszsu/90035, @kpszsu/90101, @kpszsu/90108, @kpszsu/90109)

A ballistic missile launch threat (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) was reported from Kursk region, with a separate ballistic threat alert in northern Chernihiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77503, @eRadarrua/125916)

Russian-occupied Crimea suffered a major power outage after Ukrainian strikes on key substations, affecting ~90% of the peninsula and parts of Rostov region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84867, @eRadarrua/125984)

A massive UAV attack hit a chemical plant in Tolyatti, Samara region, Russia, causing a large fire and prompting evacuation of AvtoVAZ workers; the attack occurred on October 24. (Source: @eRadarrua/125978, @eRadarrua/125981)

Russian drones targeted infrastructure in Kharkiv region (reactive UAVs past Kovyagi/Valky heading south) and Dnipropetrovsk region (reactive UAV circling near Pavlohrad). (Source: @kpszsu/90060, @mon1tor_ua/77512)

Russian forces used reactive UAVs to probe air defenses in Vinnytsia region (from Odesa region) and Rivne region (towards Zdolbuniv and Sarny). (Source: @kpszsu/90040, @kpszsu/90093, @mon1tor_ua/77502)
Zelensky's statement on readiness to freeze war at current front line suggests potential stabilization of eastern front lines, though no territorial concessions offered. (Source: @UkraineNow/84868)

Russian reactive UAV activity recorded in Dnipropetrovsk region (circling near Pavlohrad) and Kharkiv region (past Kovyagi/Valky heading south) indicates continued aerial pressure on eastern oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77512, @kpszsu/90060)
Ballistic missile threat from Kursk region (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) directly threatens eastern Ukrainian cities and front-line logistics. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77503)
Ukrainian procurement of long-range 155mm artillery shells and tactical missiles via AOZ aims to sustain eastern front artillery superiority. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23928)
Massive UAV attack on Tolyatti chemical plant deep in Russian rear demonstrates Ukrainian reach against strategic industrial targets supporting Russian war effort. (Source: @eRadarrua/125978)
No specific ground combat reports in messages; focus remains on air war and deep strikes. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77512, @kpszsu/90060)
Crimea power outage degrades Russian naval and air logistics hubs supporting southern and eastern fronts. (Source: @UkraineNow/84867, @eRadarrua/125984)

Multiple reactive UAVs entered Chernihiv region from Bryansk region past Slavutych and Snovsk, indicating persistent northern vector for Russian drone launches. (Source: @eRadarrua/125920, @eRadarrua/125923, @eRadarrua/125980, @eRadarrua/125996)

At least two Geran-5 drones approached Kyiv from Chernihiv region (Vyshhorod district) while five circled capital; air raid alert in Kyiv 01:48–04:32. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77502, @mon1tor_ua/77513, @mon1tor_ua/77512, @eRadarrua/125915, @eRadarrua/125973)
Ballistic missile threat (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) reported from Kursk region; separate ballistic threat alert in northern Chernihiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77503, @eRadarrua/125916)
Reactive UAVs detected in Zhytomyr region past Narodychi and towards Olevsk; one reactive Shahed near Cherkasy (Boryspil district). (Source: @kpszsu/90037, @kpszsu/90031, @mon1tor_ua/77512)

Russian drone from Bryansk region crossed into Chernihiv region near Slavutych; another reactive UAV from Chernihiv region headed toward Kyiv reservoir area. (Source: @eRadarrua/125920, @kpszsu/90058)
Kyiv air defense engaged drones over Hostomel and Irpin; reactive UAVs circled over Kyiv water reservoir and near Obukhiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/126020, @eRadarrua/126024, @kpszsu/90077)
No ground incursions reported; northern front remains characterized by aerial reconnaissance and strike drone penetration. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77512, @eRadarrua/125923)

Reactive UAVs launched from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv region (towards Voznesensk) and Odesa region (past Berezivka NW, past Balta toward Vinnytsia, towards Dobroslav/Buialyk). (Source: @kpszsu/90098, @kpszsu/90035, @kpszsu/90101, @kpszsu/90108, @kpszsu/90109, @kpszsu/90040)

Ukrainian strikes on Crimean substations caused ~90% peninsula blackout and power loss in parts of Rostov region, degrading Russian Black Sea Fleet and air defense logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/84867, @eRadarrua/125984)
General Staff declared humanitarian ceasefire in occupied Oleshky, Kherson region, from 03:00 October 27. (Source: @UkraineNow/84864)
Reactive UAV crossed Chernobyl exclusion zone heading west, indicating southern-to-northern transit route. (Source: @kpszsu/90099)

Russian drone activity in Odesa region included multiple vectors: past Berezivka, past Balta, towards Dobroslav/Buialyk, and from Black Sea to Mykolaiv/Odesa border. (Source: @kpszsu/90035, @kpszsu/90101, @kpszsu/90098)
No naval or amphibious activity reported; southern front dominated by aerial drone warfare and energy infrastructure targeting. (Source: @kpszsu/90098, @kpszsu/90108)
Vinnytsia region targeted by reactive UAV from Odesa region heading to southern Vinnytsia. (Source: @kpszsu/90040)

Overnight mass drone attack: ≥5 Geran-5s circled Kyiv; reactive UAVs penetrated 9+ oblasts (Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kyiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv).
